gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-switzer: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Bpmf Iansui looks squeezed from a tube in one line. Switzer answers with tall, wire-like sans letters whose c tips keep their distance, a distinctly Swiss counterpoint.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-work-sans: Work Sans reads as a modern plain sans, its c tips held apart and its mean line set high. Bpmf Iansui's toothpaste-squeezed handwriting is the more inviting voice.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-crimson-pro: Ruler-straight and a little futuristic, Bruno Ace gives each character its own beat. Crimson Pro slips in beneath it as a classic serif, packed close, with a faint thick and thin cadence.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-neco: Bruno Ace draws every line at a constant width, with counters that stay open to the outside. Neco, a dignified serif, swells gently from hairline to stem, and its letters never pinch shut across a long page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-recia: Rigid, ruler-cut and unmistakable, this heading has terminals ending exactly as wide as they began. Bruno Ace is best at stamping a confident shape, while Recia, a stencil-cut serif with mildly varied bars, rewards a closer look.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alegreya: Bruno Ace's smooth, pen-plotter lines hold the same width from the start of a stroke to its end. Alegreya, a bookish text serif, adds modest contrast.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alegreya-sc: Alegreya SC brings a traditional text serif with a wide-open s and stems a touch heavier than its crossbars. Bruno Ace, with no thick-and-thin contrast at all, feels crisp and mechanical beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alike-angular: Bruno Ace holds one steady line weight, each character taking its own unhurried beat on the line. And Alike Angular, a serif with the slight heft change of carved stone, gives that rigidity a traditional counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alyamama: Bruno Ace cuts every letter to a single line width, like sign-shop vinyl, with a lingering rhythm. Alyamama, a classic serif with soft thick-thin shifts and curve endings kept apart, reads gently.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ancizar-serif: Wire-bent and unwavering, Bruno Ace never thins at the curve of an s. Ancizar Serif steps in as a text serif with in-between contrast and a gaping c, loosening the heading's rigidity.
